reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The answer comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he would check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login. I found no later update in the channel, so I told her I can't say whether it's been fixed.

I only used sources Pree can see herself: #central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and the public Central team files. None of them gave any other site detail for Pine Crossing, such as an address or site code.
